policy: Reviewed identity inventory. Each existing baseline-untested hash is acknowledged but not tested. Never regenerate this file from detector output or relabel changed/new rules baseline-untested. New/changed rules require human-reviewed positive and negative local fixture links and updated identity; fixture changes/removals require explicit review of truth and both adapter expectations. Product/schema denominators are always the entire current catalogue, never the shared subset. Schema coverage is not per-fingerprint branch coverage or catalogue-wide accuracy. Provenance scope distinguishes synthetic-conformance from reviewed-real. Historical synthetic review dates and reviewer identities remain unknown. Real captures require source identity, collection date, authorization and sanitization assertions, and dated identified independent review; linked reviewed-real rule coverage must use only such captures. Provenance-only migration preserves prior evidence, truth, adapter expectations and rule identities.
